description: Nearest-neighbor and PCA of ENDOG vs reference sub-mito proteins
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, time
import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

prots = {
 "TFAM":("Q00059","matrix"),"POLG":("P54098","matrix"),"POLRMT":("O00411","matrix"),
 "SSBP1":("Q04837","matrix"),"LONP1":("P36776","matrix"),"SOD2":("P04179","matrix"),
 "HSPD1":("P10809","matrix"),"CS":("O75390","matrix"),
 "CYCS":("P99999","IMS"),"DIABLO":("Q9NR28","IMS"),"CHCHD4":("Q8N4Q1","IMS"),
 "HTRA2":("O43464","IMS"),"COX17":("Q14061","IMS"),"CHCHD2":("Q9Y6H1","IMS"),"TIMM13":("Q9Y5L4","IMS"),
 "EXOG":("Q9Y2C4","ctrl"),"CPS6_worm":("Q95NM6","ctrl"),"NUC1_yeast":("P08466","ctrl"),"ENDOG":("Q14249","TARGET"),
}
seqs={}; transit={}
for name,(acc,lab) in prots.items():
    seqs[name]="".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=30).text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()
    js=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=30).json()
    tp=None
    for f in js.get("features",[]):
        if f["type"]=="Transit peptide": tp=f["location"]["end"]["value"]
    transit[name]=tp; time.sleep(0.03)

pos={'K':10.8,'R':12.5,'H':6.5}; neg={'D':3.9,'E':4.1,'C':8.5,'Y':10.1}
def chg(pH,s):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-8.6))-1/(1+10**(3.6-pH))
    for a in s:
        if a in pos:q+=1/(1+10**(pH-pos[a]))
        if a in neg:q-=1/(1+10**(neg[a]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=0,14
    for _ in range(60):
        m=(lo+hi)/2
        lo,hi=(m,hi) if chg(m,s)>0 else (lo,m)
    return (lo+hi)/2
def nc(s):return sum(s.count(x) for x in 'RK')-sum(s.count(x) for x in 'DE')
def twin(s):return 1 if (re.search(r'C.{9}C.{10,40}C.{9}C',s) or re.search(r'C.{3}C.{5,40}C.{3}C',s)) else 0

feat=[]; names=[]; labs=[]
for name,(acc,lab) in prots.items():
    s=seqs[name]; tpe=transit[name]; n=tpe if tpe else 40
    pre=s[:n]; mat=s[tpe:] if tpe else s
    feat.append([ (1 if tpe else 0), nc(pre), 100*pre.count('R')/len(pre),
                  100*(pre.count('D')+pre.count('E'))/len(pre), twin(s), s.count('C'),
                  nc(mat), pI(mat) ])
    names.append(name); labs.append(lab)
F=np.array(feat,float)
cols=['transit','preNC','preArg%','preAcid%','twinCys','nCys','matNC','matpI']
Z=StandardScaler().fit_transform(F)

# nearest neighbors to ENDOG among matrix+IMS references
ei=names.index('ENDOG')
refidx=[i for i,l in enumerate(labs) if l in ('matrix','IMS')]
d=[(names[i],labs[i],np.linalg.norm(Z[ei]-Z[i])) for i in refidx]
d.sort(key=lambda x:x[2])
print("ENDOG nearest reference proteins (standardized feature distance):")
for nm,lb,dist in d[:8]: print(f"  {nm:8s} {lb:7s} dist={dist:.2f}")
# mean distance to each class
for cls in ('matrix','IMS'):
    ds=[x[2] for x in d if x[1]==cls]
    print(f"  mean dist to {cls}: {np.mean(ds):.2f} (min {np.min(ds):.2f})")

# PCA plot
p=PCA(2).fit_transform(Z)
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
col={'matrix':'tab:blue','IMS':'tab:red','ctrl':'gray','TARGET':'black'}
for i,nm in enumerate(names):
    c=col[labs[i]]; mk='*' if labs[i]=='TARGET' else 'o'
    plt.scatter(p[i,0],p[i,1],c=c,marker=mk,s=200 if mk=='*' else 70,edgecolor='k',zorder=3)
    plt.annotate(nm,(p[i,0],p[i,1]),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
plt.xlabel('PC1'); plt.ylabel('PC2')
plt.title('Sub-mitochondrial sequence-feature space (blue=matrix, red=IMS, star=ENDOG)')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('endog_pca.png',dpi=130)
print("\nENDOG features:",dict(zip(cols,[round(x,2) for x in F[ei]])))
